description: This file defines the RequestResponse class implementing the InvocationStrategyInterface for the Slim Framework. It provides a method to invoke route callables with request, response, and route parameters.

classes.name: RequestResponse
classes.description: Implements the InvocationStrategyInterface, executing a route callable with request, response, and route parameters.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the route callable, injecting route parameters into the request as attributes, and passing request, response, and route arguments to the callable.
